To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) The ATLAS experiment has a large superconducting, Air-cored Toroid Magnet System with a long Barrel and two End Cap toroids, (b) Each End Cap Toroids contains eight racetrack coil magnets mounted as a single Cold Mass, (c) The full Cold Mass assembly, 120 tonnes in weight, has been integrated into a vacuum cryostat, (d) The overall status of the Toroid Magnet integration and planning for Test and Installation are reviewed.
the cold mass and cryostat integration of the End Cap Toroids for ATLAS has been completed.
the integration of the ATLAS End Cap Toroids cold mass into the cryostat vessel was successfully completed and that the integration procedures were well planned and well executed.

the design, construction and testing of a superconducting toroid magnet system for the ATLAS detector at CERN.
the design and realization of the ATLAS end cap toroid cold mass and cryostat integration.
